name: 旧练习槽与骨孔
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 旧磨痕与浅刻槽画在骨面，无文字图标；上表面斜度较大，定位为地标装饰并检查横版视角。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE weathered bone face showing old practiced tool grooves and wear from repeated training, an R4 environmental landmark, 8 hero units wide. Long low ivory-gray organic bone slab with a natural curved outer silhouette, aged matte porous texture. Across its visible broad front face, several overlapping shallow curved scrape trails and short repeated parallel incisions, darkened and worn smooth, clearly old use-wear rather than writing. No letters, runes, numbers, arrows, target icon or glyph. The grooves are part of the bone itself; no separate tool, hook, rope, ring, plant, lamp or mechanism. Uneven softly sloping top, not standard platform, full side-view complete object with padding.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
